Field.Name: BeginString
Field.Description: Identifies beginning of new message and protocol version. Always first field in message. Value is FIX.4.2.

Field.Name: BodyLength
Field.Description: Message length, in bytes, forward to the CheckSum (10) field. Always second field in message.

Field.Name: MsgType
Field.Description: Defines message type. Always third field in message.

Field.Name: MsgSeqNum
Field.Description: Integer message sequence number.

Field.Name: PossDupFlag
Field.Description: Indicates possible retransmission of message with this sequence number. Values: Y = Possible duplicate, N = Original transmission

Field.Name: SenderCompID
Field.Description: Used to identify firm sending message. As assigned by ODX PTS.

Field.Name: SenderSubID
Field.Description: Assigned value used to identify specific message originator.

Field.Name: SendingTime
Field.Description: Time of message transmission (always expressed in UTC).

Field.Name: TargetCompID
Field.Description: Used to identify receiving firm. As assigned by ODX PTS.

Field.Name: TargetSubID
Field.Description: Assigned value used to identify specific individual or unit intended to receive message. If this field is omitted, the default value for the session will be used. Values: DAY = Daytime

Field.Name: PossResend
Field.Description: Indicates that message may contain information that has been sent under another sequence number. Values: Y = Possible resend, N = Original transmission

Field.Name: OrigSendingTime
